parsed.observations: Wheat leaf and stem/sheath tissue bear numerous reddish-brown pustules, including elongated eruptions with pale, torn epidermal margins. Pustules coalesce near the browned leaf base; no white powdery growth or black dots are visible.
parsed.summary: Visible symptoms strongly support stem rust: reddish-brown, elongated pustules on stem/sheath and leaf tissue with ragged, torn epidermal margins.
